## Confirmed and open claims
- H001 hypothesis (open): Decode with SSD streaming drains (cudaDeviceSynchronize) after every layer because queue_layers requires !g->streaming. The mid-layer selected readback (blocking hipMemcpy, null stream) already orders all prior GPU work before any expert-cache eviction/upload, so the end-of-layer drain is redundant except at the Engram layer and the last layer. Skipping it overlaps next-layer attention launches with MoE execution. Expected: a decode gain of several percent, bit-identical logits.
- M001 measurement (open): DS4_ROCM_V41_STREAM_QUEUE=1 + DS4_ROCM_V41_SHARED_FIRST=1 (opt-in): frontier logits bit-exact and generated text identical (8K gen128 x8 runs, 32K gen64 x6 runs). Decode gain small: 8K ABBA4 stream-queue alone mean +2.5 percent (per-pair +7.1/+1.8/+1.1/+0.1), 32K ABBA3 both flags +0.9 percent (all pairs >=0). Prefill unaffected. The 11.6 ms host_drain was mostly overlapped GPU work. Runs in findings/v41-stream-queue/runs.txt — evidence: gate-32k.json
- H002 hypothesis (open): Long-context prefill: the wide indexer head GEMM (FP32 Tensile MT32x32 SgemmStridedBatched + per-head scratch + reduce kernel) dominates late chunks. Q and keys are FP4xpow2 per 32-block, so a fused FP16-WMMA kernel with per-block power-of-two normalization computes exact block dots, keeps the head reduction order, writes no scratch. Expected: bit-identical scores and a prefill gain growing with context. Opt-in DS4_ROCM_V41_INDEX_WMMA=1.
- M002 measurement (open): DS4_ROCM_V41_INDEX_WMMA=1 (int8 WMMA, per-32-block pow2 normalization, exact int64 block combine): 64K frontier logits bit-exact in 2 ABBA pairs, generated text identical; prefill 171.50/170.66 -> 188.81/188.68 tps (+10.3 percent). In-model check mode found 0 score mismatches vs FP32 GEMM on 32 sampled calls; an earlier FP16-WMMA version was inexact (FP16 WMMA accumulation not exact for mixed-sign sums) and failed the 64K gate. — evidence: gate-64k-pair1.json, gate-64k-pair2.json
- M003 measurement (open): 120K frontier (ctx 131072, 92GB cache), stock defaults vs STREAM_QUEUE+SHARED_FIRST+INDEX_WMMA=1(packed, 32-row tiles)+INDEX_FP4: prefill 142.72 -> 166.93 tps (+17 percent), logits bit-exact, generated text identical (32 tokens). Decode 11.41 -> 11.14 tps, single pair, within run noise: no decode gain shown at 120K. — evidence: gate-120k-all.json
- M004 measurement (open): Faster fused scorer (queries pre-normalized once to int8, no per-head LDS/barriers, int32 exact-combine fast path): 120K frontier all flags prefill 182.46 tps vs stock 142.72 (+28 percent, single run each, same session), logits bit-exact vs stock, generated text identical. Decode 11.08 vs 11.41 tps, within noise. — evidence: gate-120k-fast.json
- M005 measurement (open): DS4_METAL_V41_DECODER_SUFFIX=1 on top of the exact flags: prefill 24K prose/code/docs 202.5/196.6/188.8 -> 311.4/312.5/307.5 tps, 120K prose 182.5 -> 380.1 tps. Not bit-exact: frontier max_abs 0.80/0.36/0.40 (24K), 0.67 (120K); argmax equal and top-k set equal at 24K on all three prompts; 128-token greedy text identical for docs, diverges after ~half for prose and code (plausible continuations). No decode penalty beyond run noise. Mathematically equivalent computation (layers 20-39 rows outside the sliding-window tail are never consumed); drift is MMQ row-block rounding (findings/codex-suffix-decision.md). — evidence: gate-24k-prose.json, gate-24k-code.json, gate-24k-docs.json, gate-120k-prose.json
- D001 decision (open): User directive (2026-11-06): every change with a gain and no regression becomes default. Promoted on ROCm, each with a =0 escape hatch: DS4_ROCM_V41_INDEX_WMMA (fused int8 WMMA indexer, packed keys), DS4_ROCM_V41_INDEX_FP4 (packed decode keys), DS4_ROCM_V41_STREAM_QUEUE, DS4_ROCM_V41_SHARED_FIRST. Default-binary check at 32K gen 64: logits bit-exact vs stock, text identical, all batch scoring on the fused kernel. Decoder suffix stays opt-in (changes outputs) pending user decision. — evidence: gate-32k-defaults.json
- D002 decision (open): Decoder suffix made ROCm default (DS4_METAL_V41_DECODER_SUFFIX=0 disables) with new DS4_ROCM_V41_SUFFIX_MIN_ROWS=4096: layers 20-39 compute at least their last 4096 rows so the post-prefill expert-cache seed sees enough routes (plain suffix left 778 slots empty, decode misses 557 vs 321, decode -11 percent). 24K prose gen128 ABBA2: decode 10.86 (off) vs 11.26 (on), prefill 199 -> 308 tps. Long-prefix (16384) perplexity on 512 scored tokens off -> on: prose 4.0458 -> 4.0224, code 1.1247 -> 1.1250, docs 2.7488 -> 2.7542 (mixed sign, rounding-level). Runs in findings/v41-decoder-suffix/decode-ab.txt. — evidence: gate-24k-prose.json
- M006 measurement (open): Decode, all ROCm default, each =0 disables, bit-exact (frontier logits + identical 128-token text in every run): (1) DS4_ROCM_V41_ENGRAM_ASYNC: the 2x24 per-token Engram disk rows are read concurrently by a persistent 16-thread pool and awaited only at layer 1; (2) DS4_ROCM_V41_Q8_DECODE_ROUND: single-row Q8 GEMV rounds to bf16 in its epilogue, removing ~80 launches/token; (3) DS4_ROCM_V41_PTRS_ZERO_COPY: the decode expert pointer table lives in coherent mapped host memory, removing 3 H2D copies + cross-stream event per layer (a ~53 us copyBuffer stall, 2.1 ms/token of GPU time). 24K gen128 ABBA3 (1)+(2)+(3) off vs on: 11.39 -> 11.74 tps (+3.1 percent, 3/3). (4) DS4_ROCM_NORM_BATCHED: RMS norm loads batched 8 ahead with the same accumulation order (unit-tested bit-identical, 16.6 -> 4.7 us for n=20480); ABBA3 11.68 -> 11.85 tps (+1.5 percent, 3/3). 96GB cache: misses 827 -> 765 per 512 tokens, decode unchanged; kept 92GB. — evidence: gate-24k-dab.json, gate-24k-norm.json
